ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate ratio of 0.35 high-intensity (white/light grey) to 0.65 low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Diffuse, irregular light-grey mottling concentrated in the central-lateral regions of both lobes. Significant white clusters are mapped to the inner-upper quadrant of the left lobe and a large focal patch on the medial-outer section of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an estimated internal pixel angle of 42 degrees and a depth of approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular serration along the entire trailing boundary. Left lobe features a major notch-like indentation at the midpoint of the trailing edge. Right lobe contains a sequence of 7-9 shallow peaks with low pixel amplitude variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer margins exhibit a convex curvature sweeping from the notch towards the distal tips, which terminate in sharp, upward-pointing acute angles.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white circular spots (rosettes) are visible on the distal tip of the right lobe and along its upper lateral edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two prominent, nearly vertical parallel white rake marks are detected on the inner region of the left lobe near the waterline, with a third shorter mark situated medially to them.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent vertical linear scars (rake marks) on the inner left lobe; circular depigmented lesions at the extreme tip of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A single, isolated high-intensity white dot located in the lower-central dark region of the right lobe lobe.
